positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Experimentation
positions.description:

Building front-ends for configuring experiments and viewing experiment schedules

Building scalable and performant batch/adhoc data pipelines to compute causal inference results

Mentoring full-stack / backend engineers and interns

Built and maintained data visualization libraries, front-end dashboarding framework, drag-and-drop query builders, and job scheduling infrastructure.
